title: Speaking — News about science
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on news about science.

questions: Where do you usually go if you need to study or read?
Do you prefer to learn in the morning or evening?
How do you keep track of what you have learned?
What helps you get back to studying after a break?
Where do you hear about new scientific findings?
Do you read explanations of how everyday things work?

part2.topic: Describe a scientific explanation that helped you understand a familiar event.
part2.closing: and explain why you found the explanation persuasive.

questions: How should journalists report new scientific findings with important uncertainties?
What can scientists do to reach audiences who seldom read about research?
How has everyday life connected with news about science changed for people of different ages?
